---
title: "ggplot png"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
    fig-format: png
    fig-dpi: 110
execute: {warning: false}
---

```{r}
#| label: fig-scatter
#| fig-cap: "Scatter"
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg, colour = factor(cyl))) + geom_point(size = 3)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-hist
#| fig-cap: "Histogram"
ggplot(faithful, aes(eruptions)) + geom_histogram(bins = 25)
```

See @fig-scatter and @fig-hist.
